0022600041.text: Portland visits Sacramento for its 12th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup, with the Trail Blazers at 8-3, first in the Northwest and fourth in the West, on a two-game winning streak and 5-1 on the road. The Kings are 1-10, 14th in the West and 9 games back in the Pacific, on a four-game losing streak and 0-6 at home, and Portland won their only meeting this season 128-120 in Sacramento on 2026-10-23. Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) and is monitoring Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise), who is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
